items.title: [AI suggestions] NB-3: README references non-existent "env" section in docker-compose
items.summary:
## Finding

`README.md:42` states:

> docker-compose passes it to the container via the `env` section in `docker-compose.yml`.

This is factually wrong. The compose file uses the `environment` attribute (`docker-compose.yml:15-16`):

```yaml
environment:
  - GOOGLE_API_KEY=${GOOGLE_API_KEY:-}
```
